verdict.rationale: Semgrep is a security scanning tool, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question here, and a probe confirms an official MCP server documented at docs.semgrep.dev/mcp. Beyond that existence check, the pack has no detail on the tools it exposes, how to set it up, how agents connect, or its maturity. Missing for 10: documented tool surface and agent connection/setup steps, transport and auth details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://docs.semgrep.dev/mcp
